name: What is the typical cost range for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen remodel costs vary significantly based on the scope, materials chosen, and the size of your kitchen. A minor remodel, updating surfaces and appliances without changing the layout, might range from $15,000 to $30,000. A mid-range remodel, involving new cabinetry, countertops, and some layout changes, could be $30,000 to $60,000. High-end or major remodels, with custom elements and significant structural changes, can exceed $75,000. We provide detailed quotes after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen remodel costs range from $15,000 for minor updates to over $75,000 for major renovations, depending on scope and materials.
